expectedIssues: Fastest near you carousel card heights are misaligned with each other
reportedIssues: In 'Fastest near you' row, the '20-30 min' badge on 'Smash Bros Burgers' straddles the bottom edge of the image and sits half outside on the white background, while badges on neighboring cards are fully inside the image. The middle card image also appears vertically offset lower than the adjacent cards.

Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows a bare white outline heart directly on the photo with no background, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark translucent circular scrim, making the first icon low-contrast and hard to see.
